text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing, Mejiro
Palmer
detours us into a cafe she's been
keen on visiting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, it's been ages since I came here. I
used
come here all the time when I was a
kid, and...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey Rice! Did you drop in here for a

breather?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-hello! Umm, yes!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
This cafe looks just like the one in my
favorite picture book. I enjoy being
here—it makes me feel like I'm inside the
story. The big bookshelves are exactly
like the ones in the book, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The big bookshelves, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Could that book you're talking about be The Fairy Cafe, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's the one. But Palmer, how did
you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wait! I remember now! Your mother's
the one
who—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wrote the book? Yep, that's her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was just saying how I used to
come here
all the time, right? Well, my
mom was the one
who would bring me.

text_block_list.name: Young Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Look, Mama! There're books aaall the
way up
there! How do you get them
down?!

text_block_list.name: Palmer's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Oh! Maybe you have to ask
fairies to help
get them for you?

text_block_list.name: Young Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! What kind of fairies?! Are they
friendly?

text_block_list.name: Palmer's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I bet they're fairies that wear
glasses, and they can use their glasses to
see into a person's heart. So I'm sure you
can become the best of friends with
them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oooh... That's so amazing! You were the
one who
came up with the story!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Naaah! I just happened to be
there when
she got that idea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mom was always like that, adding things
to my
silly ramblings. Next thing I knew,
they were made
into a book.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Talking with her was, like, the most fun
thing
ever. She took me everywhere,
too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Were there other books she wrote
that came
about in the same way?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I'm pretty sure there was this one
time my
family and I all went to the
park, and...

text_block_list.name: Young Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wooow... That tulip is so tall!

text_block_list.name: Palmer's Mother
text_block_list.text:
She must be a bold princess showing off
her dress.
I wonder if that means we're in
the Flower
Kingdom right now?

text_block_list.name: Young Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The flowers must be holding a ball in
their pretty
dresses! Mama, let's dance
with them, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it went something like that. Being
with Mom was lotsa fun 'cause it always
felt like I was
an adventurer, exploring
different worlds!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-um, I feel the same way! Whenever I
read the
books your mother wrote...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It always feels like there's another world
in the
pages, and I'm always so excited
to visit them!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So, um... Thank you for blessing me with
the
opportunity to explore such
wonderful worlds!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And thanks for the kind words, too. I'll
let Mom
know what you said!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I had no idea Rice was one of my
mom's
fans. It's almost hilarious how
obvious it should've
been.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Knowing Mom's books make
someone
else's life better makes me
proud to be her
daughter.
choice_data_list: That was quite a pleasant surprise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I grew up watching my mom working
hard and
doing her best all the time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: Can't afford to lose either, huh.
You can't afford to lose either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You know, Mom actually wants to write
a new
picture book based off me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And, like, I'd love to help out, but I
asked her to
hold off it for now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if she wrote a new book, I'd be
part of a
glamorous world that
transforms someone else's
life.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But I don't want to be seen just yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I want to win lots more races and work
even
harder than Mom.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I want to get published in a book after I reach peak wahey! Y'know what I mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I want to get published in a book after I reach peak wahey! Y'know what I mean?
choice_data_list: When that happens, make sure you s...
When that time comes, be sure to s...
Looks like it'll make for a great ...
Looks like it'll make for a wonder...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why're you saying that as if you're
not gonna be involved? If I'm gonna be
in the book, then
you're obvs gonna be
in it, too!
choice_data_list: When that happens, make sure you s...
When that time comes, be sure to s...
Looks like it'll make for a great ...
Looks like it'll make for a wonder...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
After all, there's no talking about me
without
talking about you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna be right there with me
autographing books, so you'd better be
prepared! Let's do our
best when the big
day comes! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'll make it amazing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to call Mom and tell her
my big
plan. I'll let her know about
Rice's glowing review,
too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her giddiness is absolutely
heartwarming. I can't
wait to be in a
picture book someday, too.
